description: §19.16.3 rule 4 — `defer` in an event-handler attribute inside a component definition (`const Btn = <button onclick=${ defer [1].forEach(f) }>`) is E-DEFER-OUTSIDE-FUNCTION, exactly once. A component body is carried as raw markup text until it is expanded at each use, and a handler attribute is not a function-declaration body. Before the S432 review fix the default front-end compiled this CLEAN and the button threw a ReferenceError (`defer` is not defined) at click.
rationale: §19.16.3 rule 4: `defer` SHALL appear only inside the body of a function DECLARATION; it is E-DEFER-OUTSIDE-FUNCTION in every other position — including a handler attribute of markup written in a component definition.
